title: 服务对接配置
description: 连接您的太忆空间账号以调用跨 Agent 长期记忆服务。凭证仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录下，不会上传云端。
description_en: Connect your TiMEM Space account to use cross-agent long-term memory services. Credentials are stored locally only in ~/.workbuddy and never uploaded.
docLabel_en: How to get an API Key?

fields.label: API Key
fields.placeholder: 登录 space.timem.cloud → 设置 → API 密钥 → 创建 API 密钥
fields.description: 用于访问太忆空间 MCP 服务的个人访问令牌，连接时通过 X-API-Key 请求头注入。
